title: Work Backwards
summary: Undo the last step first, and go back to the start.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: I think of a number, double it, add 6 and get 20.
points: I think of a number, double it, add 6 and get 20.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Forwards is hard because you do not know the start.
Undo each step from the end.
points: Forwards is hard because you do not know the start.

steps.title: The method: Reverse the steps
sentences: The last step was add 6, so subtract 6 from 20 to get 14.
The step before was double, so halve 14 to get 7.
points: The last step was add 6, so subtract 6 from 20 to get 14.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: Working backwards undoes each step in the opposite order.
It is a great way to solve many puzzles.
